perks.description: Melee final blows with this weapon grant it bonus energy and provide increased movement speed while blocking.

perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant your projectiles tracking and increase reload speed. Dealing further damage extends the duration.

enhanced.name: Beacon Rounds

perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Heal Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Butterfly
perks.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Butterfly
enhanced.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

enhanced.name: Unstoppable Force

enhanced.name: Box Breathing

enhanced.name: Mega Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

enhanced.name: Close to Melee
